saw_lines: Hair buyers choose by curl pattern and hair type, then reorder the same conditioner for months.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where buyers check whether the ad fits their hair.
Your 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have nothing to check. Collect a review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the claim. Collect one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

7 of 30 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, which makes a new buyer see an ad, not a recommendation. Whitelist those posts from the creator account and cut three variations of the best one.

5 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. Buyers who clicked for one item must search again before they can buy. Point each of the 5 to the product it shows, such as the sculpting pomade.

Your site promotes free shipping on orders $30+, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Open new buyer ads with the free shipping line and the $30 threshold printed on the creative.
